description: Compare installed labsUI items with this labsUI version. Returns a unified patch per changed file, from the registry file to the project file (+ lines exist only in the project), with formatting: true when only blank lines or indentation differ and changedBy saying whose change it is since the installed version: upstream (only labsUI changed it; update replaces the file), local (only you did; update keeps it) or both (update merges), unset when that version can't be fetched; matching items are left out, a named item that isn't installed comes back with installed: false, and when nothing differs it says so. Use it before update to see what it will do. Needs init.

names.description: Installed item names, e.g. button. Empty: all installed items.

name: diff
title: Diff installed labsUI items
